title: Rav Chana bar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Sukkah 52b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.52b.7), reporting a teaching from Rav’s school: “Four things the Holy One, blessed be He, regrets having created: exile, the Chaldeans, the Ishmaelites and the evil inclination.” Hyman gives Rav Chana bar Ada as the reading in Dikdukei Soferim and Ravin bar Rav Acha as the reading in Ein Yaakov.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1375&lang=en) both name Rav Chana bar Acha reporting what was said in Rav’s school. The other named readings are Hyman’s reports.
